segments.vo: This is Korea's seventeen-thousand-won fix: Illiyoon Ceramide Ato Soothing Gel.
Dermatologist tested, allergy tested, fragrance free. It's all on the label.
Inside: soy ceramide for your moisture barrier, plus madecassoside, the calming part of cica.
A cooling gel that sinks in fast. Koreans use it on face, arms and legs.
Seventeen thousand nine hundred won, about thirteen dollars. Abroad, around twenty-seven.
Get it if your skin turns red and tight. Skip it if you want a rich cream.
Save this for your Olive Young run, and comment your skin type.

shorts.title: Korea's $13 gel for sensitive skin (it's $27 abroad)
shorts.description:
ILLIYOON Ceramide Ato Soothing Gel 175 ml, made by Amorepacific.

• List price ₩17,900 (~$13) in Korea, often discounted at Olive Young
• About $27 at US K-beauty shops
• Soy-ceramide™ for the moisture barrier + madecassoside (cica) to calm
• Dermatologist tested, allergy tested, fragrance free, 10-free
• Face, arms and legs: one tube

Get it if your skin turns red and tight. Skip it if you want a rich cream.

Voice: AI narration. Footage: filmed in Seoul.
